Class FaissBinaryIndexBindings

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissBinaryIndexBindings
public final class FaissBinaryIndexBindings extends Object
FFM bindings for FAISS Binary Index operations (IndexBinary_c.h, IndexBinaryFlat_c.h, IndexBinaryIVF_c.h).
